release_summary: UMM adds Windows-style drag-box selection across all six bags and a right-side Recently sent pane using the shared 20-recipient history. Ctrl/Shift-drag adds, Escape/right-click cancels, existing click/group toggles remain, and unfinished selections stop on bag changes, navigation or close. The mass-send window expands and fits the viewport; recipient selection preserves committed marks. C.O.D./sending blocks recipient changes, and active queue sending locks all four tabs. Kitty's mode picker rejects delayed clicks after closing/native hiding. The 0.11.82 development features carry forward: RWA clickthrough, scale/screen transforms, grips/reset and HP/percentage; UMM shared last-recipient/gold shortcuts and History tab; Kitty mode pickers/changemode actions. Earlier fixes and 0.2-second dispatch/1.1-second prediction carry forward. Overhead emoji pictures remain unimplemented because the inspected client lacks the required hook.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 596 tests, 570 passed and 26 pre-existing skips. The 34 focused UMM tests include 23 new drag-box/sidebar cases covering native click-before-mouseup ordering, modifiers, scaled geometry, cancellation, bag replacements, bound-item exclusions, bounded widgets, queue startup/stop, shared recent recipients and viewport fitting. A reproduced Kitty regression now rejects delayed HUD/editor picker clicks after close or native hiding. Native drawing, mouse capture/focus, sidebar layout and live mail timing still need in-game validation. Earlier RWA/Kitty native-client limits and the unimplemented overhead emoji limitation remain documented.
